formattingPolicy: All archived text uses LF with text eol=lf Git attributes so committed bytes match SHA256. Markdown prose has trailing whitespace removed, hard breaks expressed with a backslash and one final newline. Fenced/indented/preformatted code and non-Markdown source text retain meaningful line whitespace; exact-file Git whitespace exceptions record retained source whitespace.
